extracted.name: Moist Chocolate Cake
extracted.description: Great recipe for Moist Chocolate Cake.
instruction_lines: Mix well all dry ingredients; flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder then add eggs, buttermilk, water, oil and vanilla. Whisk on medium speed until well combined.
Bake in a 180 degC for about 20 minutes.
Let it cool completely then decorate cupcakes & cake as you wish. Enjoy!
